expected_memories.content_gist: Requirement 03.05.06 is withdrawn for consistency with SP 800-53

Password management requires maintaining a list of commonly used, expected or compromised passwords and updating it at an organization-defined frequency and when organizational passwords are suspected to have been compromised
Passwords must be verified against the list of commonly used, expected or compromised passwords when users create or update them
Passwords must be transmitted only over cryptographically protected channels
Passwords must be stored in a cryptographically protected form
A new password must be selected upon first use after account recovery
Organization-defined composition and complexity rules for passwords must be enforced
Requirement 03.05.08 is withdrawn for consistency with SP 800-53
Requirement 03.05.09 is withdrawn for consistency with SP 800-53
Requirement 03.05.10 is withdrawn and incorporated into 03.05.07
Requirement 03.05.11: obscure feedback of authentication information during the authentication process
Authenticator management requires verifying the identity of the individual, group, role, service or device receiving the authenticator as part of the initial distribution
Authenticator management requires establishing initial authenticator content for any authenticators issued by the organization

must_not_extract: the running head (NIST SP 800-171r3, Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information, May 2024) and the page numbers
the REFERENCES blocks (Source Controls, Supporting Publications)
the DISCUSSION prose explaining why composition rules give marginal benefit
an invented value for the organization-defined frequency or the organization-defined composition rules, which the document deliberately leaves open
